title: Canonical evidence
summary: Canonical evidence is selectively readable through profile, identity, project pattern, employers, systems, facts, metrics, boundaries and accomplishments. The application contract remains planned.
body:
Planned boundary: receives Candidate evidence and user corrections; produces Typed evidence records and resolved fact text. Owns Candidate facts, restrictions and authorized retrofit policy. Must preserve: Preserve employers, dates and original evidence; an added fact does not by itself change the record schema. Inspect actual code before claiming this boundary is already enforced.
Context migration exposes existing canonical.yaml records with exact source ranges. Empty evidence categories stay explicit. These records do not constitute fresh human confirmation of migrated content.
